## Change

Describe the behavior and scope of this change.

## Validation

- [ ] `required-ci` passed; database/storage/AI tests use isolated services.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, or unrelated unfinished work included.
- [ ] Migrations reviewed; staging verification and production recovery plan recorded when applicable.

For releases: link staging QA evidence, tested commit/tree, migration approval,
previous production deployment, smoke results and proposed version tag.
For hotfixes: link follow-up synchronization PRs into staging and develop.
